company.description: Copper Health provides an AI-powered remote therapeutic monitoring and patient engagement platform for physical therapy practices. The company focuses on automating RTM workflows such as eligibility verification, data tracking, compliance documentation, and monthly billing support. Its platform enables practices to monitor home exercise programs and patient progress through SMS-based check-ins and reminders without requiring a mobile app. Copper Health integrates with electronic medical record systems to sync patient information and reduce manual data entry. The service supports both full-service and self-serve models, allowing clinicians and practices to select the level of operational assistance they need.
